result.instructions: Tools for Feefo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show my latest 1 and 2 star Feefo reviews from the last month."; "What is my average Feefo service rating and star breakdown this year?"; "Which products have the best average rating? Show the top 10 by rating.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Feefo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run feefo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run feefo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run feefo_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. feefo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: feefo_list_reviews
tools.description: List reviews of your Feefo account, newest updates first. mode: all (service + product, default), service (seller/service reviews), product (product reviews; give product_sku or parent_product_sku) or nps (Net Promoter Score responses). Returns summary.meta (count, pages) and reviews[] with ratings, comment text, customer display name and review threads. Page with page/page_size.

product_sku.description: Product SKU (required for mode=product unless parent_product_sku is set). Comma-separated list allowed.

rating.description: Only reviews with this rating: 1-5 stars; for mode=nps the 0-10 score

since_period.description: Reviews created within this period (Feefo default: year). Use 'all' for the whole history.

unanswered_feedback.description: Whether unanswered low-rated feedback from the last 48 hours is included (Feefo default: include)

empty_product_comments.description: Whether product reviews with no text comment are included

origin.description: Origin/domain (needed when several domains share the feed)

order_reference.description: Only the review(s) for this order reference (needs the App Key)

customer_reference.description: Only reviews for this customer reference (needs the App Key)

full_thread.description: Include the full exchange (replies, rating changes) on each review

tools.name: feefo_get_review
tools.description: Get one review by its id (the `id` of a service or product element from feefo_list_reviews), optionally with its full thread of replies.

tools.name: feefo_get_review_summary
tools.description: Aggregate ratings for your Feefo account: average rating and star distribution (1 to 5 stars) for service and product reviews, merchant details, review counts. mode: all (default), service, product (needs product_sku or parent_product_sku) or nps (promoters/passives/detractors). Use since_period=all for lifetime figures (Feefo default: the last year).

product_sku.description: Product SKU (required for mode=product unless parent_product_sku is set). Comma-separated list allowed.

rating.description: Only reviews with this rating: 1-5 stars; for mode=nps the 0-10 score

since_period.description: Reviews created within this period (Feefo default: year). Use 'all' for the whole history.

unanswered_feedback.description: Whether unanswered low-rated feedback from the last 48 hours is included (Feefo default: include)

empty_product_comments.description: Whether product reviews with no text comment are included

origin.description: Origin/domain (needed when several domains share the feed)

order_reference.description: Only the review(s) for this order reference (needs the App Key)

customer_reference.description: Only reviews for this customer reference (needs the App Key)

tools.name: feefo_get_product_ratings
tools.description: Average star rating per product SKU (products[] with rating, sku and optionally review_count). Filter by product_sku (comma-separated, leading/trailing * wildcards allowed) or parent_product_sku.

review_count.description: Also return how many reviews back each rating

since_period.description: Reviews counted from this period (default year)

summary.description: Also return merchant and pagination information

tools.name: feefo_reply_to_review
tools.description: WRITE: publish a public reply to a review on your Feefo account, optionally emailing the customer (notify_customer). Visible to the public on your Feefo page and not undoable through this server. `review_id` is the `id` of the service or product element returned by feefo_list_reviews (not the outer review url id). Confirm the wording with the user first.

review_id.description: Id of the individual service or product review element

author.description: Name shown as the author of the reply, for example 'Customer Care Team'

notify_customer.description: Email the customer that you replied (default false)
